(Translated by Google)
Excellent service and very honest staff. In my case, I left my cell phone on the table, they found it, put it away, answered my call from another number, and returned it to me. A GESTURE THAT THE REST OF SOCIETY SHOULD EMULATE. Very good coffee and a good variety of sweet and savory snacks.
